//: app/src/main/python/main.py imports the shared export package out of python/, which is not
installed - Chaquopy packages it by path and the exporter runs it from the source tree. So
without this pyright reports every one of those imports as unresolved, and the check that is
supposed to catch real mistakes drowns them in noise instead.
Kept here rather than in the workflow so the command CONTRIBUTING.md tells contributors to run
locally is the same one CI runs, and so Pylance resolves it in an editor too.
python/ itself is deliberately not checked: it has pre-existing errors and needs its own
cleanup first. This only makes it importable.
